title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Blocks
description: Defines Block, Header, Withdrawal, Log, and Receipt data structures for the Osaka fork. Header includes blob_gas_used, excess_blob_gas, parent_beacon_block_root, and requests_hash fields.

sub_graphs.name: Withdrawal Data Structure
sub_graphs.description: Represents a transfer of ETH from the consensus layer (beacon chain) to the execution layer. Each withdrawal is listed in the block's withdrawals list and is validated by the consensus layer.

invariants.text: Withdrawal struct is immutable (slotted_freezable decorator enforces frozen dataclass semantics).
Withdrawal index must be unique and incrementing for each withdrawal processed.

state_transitions.text: A Withdrawal transfers ETH from the consensus layer to the execution-layer address specified in the 'address' field, crediting the 'amount' of ETH.

fields.name: index
fields.description: The unique index of the withdrawal, incremented for each withdrawal processed.

fields.name: validator_index
fields.description: The index of the validator on the consensus layer that is withdrawing.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The execution-layer address receiving the withdrawn ETH.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The amount of ETH being withdrawn.

sub_graphs.name: Block Header Data Structure
sub_graphs.description: Header portion of a block on the chain, containing metadata and cryptographic commitments to the block's contents. Includes fields for PoS consensus, EIP-1559 base fee, EIP-4844 blob gas tracking, beacon chain integration, and EIP-7685 requests hash.

invariants.text: Header struct is immutable (slotted_freezable decorator enforces frozen dataclass semantics).
In post-merge (PoS) forks, ommers_hash is always EMPTY_OMMER_HASH.
In PoS, difficulty is set to a constant value (0).
In PoS, nonce is set to zero.
gas_used must be less than or equal to gas_limit.
gas_limit can only be adjusted by a factor of 1/1024 from the parent block's gas_limit, up to a maximum of 30 million gas.
Base fees (EIP-1559) are burned and do not go to the coinbase address.
state_root is computed via the state_root() function as the root of the Merkle-Patricia Trie representing Ethereum world state.
transactions_root is computed via the root() function over the Merkle-Patricia trie of transactions.
receipt_root is computed via the root() function over the Merkle-Patricia trie of receipts.
requests_hash is computed as the SHA2-256 hash of all collected requests via compute_requests_hash (EIP-7685).
excess_blob_gas is a running total that can decrease to a minimum of zero but never goes negative (EIP-4844).

fields.name: parent_hash
fields.description: Hash (keccak256) of the parent block's header, encoded with RLP.

fields.name: ommers_hash
fields.description: Hash (keccak256) of the ommers (uncle blocks), always EMPTY_OMMER_HASH in post-merge forks.

fields.name: coinbase
fields.description: Address of the validator who produced this block. Receives block reward and priority fees (tips).

fields.name: state_root
fields.description: Root hash (keccak256) of the state trie after executing all transactions in this block.

fields.name: transactions_root
fields.description: Root hash (keccak256) of the transactions trie containing all transactions in original order.

fields.name: receipt_root
fields.description: Root hash (keccak256) of the receipts trie containing all receipts for transactions.

fields.name: bloom
fields.description: Bloom filter for logs generated by transactions in this block.

fields.name: difficulty
fields.description: Difficulty of the block (pre-PoS), or a constant in PoS.

fields.name: number
fields.description: Block number (height) in the chain.

fields.name: gas_limit
fields.description: Maximum gas allowed in this block. Adjustable by factor of 1/1024 from parent, up to 30M gas.

fields.name: gas_used
fields.description: Total gas used by all transactions in this block.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp of when the block was produced, in seconds since the unix epoch.

fields.name: extra_data
fields.description: Arbitrary data included by the miner/validator.

fields.name: prev_randao
fields.description: Output of the RANDAO beacon for random validator selection.

fields.name: nonce
fields.description: Nonce used in mining (pre-PoS), set to zero in PoS.

fields.name: base_fee_per_gas
fields.description: Base fee per gas for transactions in this block (EIP-1559). Minimum fee per gas for inclusion.

fields.name: withdrawals_root
fields.description: Root hash of the withdrawals trie containing all withdrawals in this block.

fields.name: blob_gas_used
fields.description: Total blob gas consumed by transactions within this block (EIP-4844).

fields.name: excess_blob_gas
fields.description: Running total of blob gas consumed in excess of the target, prior to this block (EIP-4844). Minimum zero.

fields.name: parent_beacon_block_root
fields.description: Root hash of the corresponding beacon chain block.

fields.name: requests_hash
fields.description: SHA2-256 hash of all collected requests in this block (EIP-7685). Computed via compute_requests_hash.

sub_graphs.name: Block Data Structure
sub_graphs.description: A complete block on Ethereum composed of a block header, a list of transactions, a list of ommers (deprecated, always empty in PoS), and a list of validator withdrawals.

invariants.text: Block struct is immutable (slotted_freezable decorator enforces frozen dataclass semantics).
In PoS, ommers tuple is always empty.
Transactions can be any of: LegacyTransaction, AccessListTransaction, FeeMarketTransaction, BlobTransaction, or SetCodeTransaction.

fields.name: header
fields.description: The block header containing metadata and cryptographic commitments.

fields.name: transactions
fields.description: A tuple of transactions included in this block.

fields.name: ommers
fields.description: A tuple of ommers (uncle blocks). Always empty in PoS forks.

fields.name: withdrawals
fields.description: A tuple of withdrawals processed in this block.

sub_graphs.name: Log Data Structure
sub_graphs.description: Data record produced during the execution of a transaction. Logs are emitted by smart contracts using EVM log opcodes (LOG0-LOG4).

invariants.text: Log struct is immutable (slotted_freezable decorator enforces frozen dataclass semantics).
A log can have up to four topics (enforced by LOG0-LOG4 opcode semantics).

fields.name: address
fields.description: The address of the contract that emitted the log.

fields.name: topics
fields.description: A tuple of up to four topics associated with the log, used for filtering.

fields.name: data
fields.description: The data payload of the log.

sub_graphs.name: Receipt Data Structure
sub_graphs.description: Result of a transaction execution. Receipts are included in the receipts trie.

invariants.text: Receipt struct is immutable (slotted_freezable decorator enforces frozen dataclass semantics).
cumulative_gas_used is monotonically non-decreasing across receipts within a block.

fields.name: succeeded
fields.description: Whether the transaction execution was successful.

fields.name: cumulative_gas_used
fields.description: Total gas used in the block up to and including this transaction.

fields.name: bloom
fields.description: Bloom filter for logs generated by this transaction.

fields.name: logs
fields.description: A tuple of logs generated by this transaction.

sub_graphs.name: Receipt Encoding Function
sub_graphs.description: Encodes a transaction receipt based on the transaction type. Typed transactions prefix their receipt with a type byte and RLP-encode the body; legacy transactions return the receipt as-is.

invariants.text: Receipt encoding type prefix must match the transaction type: 0x01=AccessList, 0x02=FeeMarket, 0x03=Blob, 0x04=SetCode.
Legacy transaction receipts are returned without any prefix or additional encoding.
encode_receipt and decode_receipt are inverse operations: decode_receipt(encode_receipt(tx, receipt)) == receipt for all valid tx and receipt.

pre_conditions.text: The tx parameter must be a valid Transaction type.
The receipt parameter must be a valid Receipt instance.

post_conditions.text: For typed transactions, the return value is a Bytes object with the type prefix byte followed by the RLP-encoded receipt.
For legacy transactions, the return value is the Receipt object unchanged.

functions.name: encode_receipt
functions.signature: def encode_receipt(tx: Transaction, receipt: Receipt) -> Bytes | Receipt
functions.description: Encodes a transaction receipt based on the transaction type.

parameters.name: tx
parameters.description: The transaction whose type determines the encoding scheme.

logic: If tx is AccessListTransaction: return b'\x01' + rlp.encode(receipt)
If tx is FeeMarketTransaction: return b'\x02' + rlp.encode(receipt)
If tx is BlobTransaction: return b'\x03' + rlp.encode(receipt)
If tx is SetCodeTransaction: return b'\x04' + rlp.encode(receipt)

sub_graphs.name: Receipt Decoding Function
sub_graphs.description: Decodes a receipt from its serialized form. Typed receipts are stripped of their prefix and RLP-decoded; legacy receipts are returned as-is.

invariants.text: Only type prefix bytes 1, 2, 3, and 4 are valid for Bytes receipts; any other prefix triggers an assertion error.
decode_receipt is the inverse of encode_receipt.

pre_conditions.text: If receipt is Bytes, its first byte must be one of {1, 2, 3, 4}.
If receipt is Bytes, the remaining bytes must be valid RLP-encoded Receipt data.

post_conditions.text: The return value is always a Receipt instance.

functions.name: decode_receipt
functions.description: Decodes a receipt from its serialized form.
logic: If receipt is Bytes: assert receipt[0] in (1, 2, 3, 4), then return rlp.decode_to(Receipt, receipt[1:])

sub_graphs.description: Import declarations establishing the module's dependencies.

title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Bloom
description: Implements Ethereum logs bloom filter functions: add_to_bloom and logs_bloom for the Osaka fork.

sub_graphs.name: Module Overview and Imports
sub_graphs.description: Ethereum Logs Bloom module for the Osaka fork. Defines functions for calculating bloom filters of logs. Bloom filters are 256-byte (2048-bit) bitfields where entries are hashed via keccak256 and 3 bits are set per entry.

invariants.text: A Bloom filter is always exactly 256 bytes (2048 bits) in size.
The bloom filter uses exactly 3 hash functions, derived from the first three 16-bit big-endian words of the keccak256 hash of each entry.

sub_graphs.name: Bloom Entry Addition (add_to_bloom)
sub_graphs.description: Core function that adds a single entry to a bloom filter. Computes the keccak256 hash, extracts the least significant 11 bits from each of the first three 16-bit big-endian words to determine which bits to set.

invariants.text: Exactly 3 bit positions are computed per call to add_to_bloom, from byte offsets (0,1), (2,3), and (4,5) of the keccak256 hash.
Each bit position is derived by masking with 0x07FF, yielding a value in the range [0, 2047].
Bits in the bloom filter are only ever set (bitwise OR), never cleared.
The bloom bytearray is indexed from the most significant byte (index 0). bit_index = 0x07FF - bit_to_set; byte_index = bit_index // 8; bit_value = 1 << (7 - (bit_index % 8)).

pre_conditions.text: bloom must be a mutable bytearray of exactly 256 bytes.
bloom_entry must be a valid Bytes value.

post_conditions.text: After execution, up to 3 additional bits in bloom are set. Previously set bits remain set.
No bits that were previously set in bloom are cleared.

state_transitions.text: For each idx in {0, 2, 4}: bit_to_set = Uint.from_be_bytes(keccak256(bloom_entry)[idx:idx+2]) & 0x07FF; bit_index = 0x07FF - int(bit_to_set); byte_index = bit_index // 8; bit_value = 1 << (7 - (bit_index % 8)); bloom[byte_index] |= bit_value.

functions.name: add_to_bloom
functions.signature: def add_to_bloom(bloom: bytearray, bloom_entry: Bytes) -> None
functions.description: Adds a bloom entry to the bloom filter by computing keccak256 and setting 3 bits.

parameters.name: bloom
parameters.description: The bloom filter (256 bytes). Modified in-place.

parameters.name: bloom_entry
parameters.description: An entry to add to the bloom filter.

state_variables.name: byte_index
state_variables.description: Index of the byte in the bloom bytearray (bit_index // 8).

sub_graphs.name: Logs Bloom Construction (logs_bloom)
sub_graphs.description: Constructs a complete logs bloom filter from a tuple of log entries. Initializes a zero-filled 256-byte bytearray, adds each log's address and topics via add_to_bloom, returns the Bloom.

invariants.text: The logs bloom is initialized as a zero-filled 256-byte bytearray before any entries are added.
For every log, the address is added first, followed by each topic in order.
The resulting Bloom is deterministic for the same input logs.
If logs is empty, the returned Bloom is all zeros.

pre_conditions.text: logs must be a tuple of valid Log objects with address and topics fields.

post_conditions.text: The returned Bloom contains set bits for every address and every topic across all log entries.
The returned Bloom is exactly 256 bytes.

state_transitions.text: Fresh 256-byte zero bytearray created. For each log: add_to_bloom(bloom, log.address), then for each topic: add_to_bloom(bloom, topic). Wrapped in Bloom() and returned.

functions.name: logs_bloom
functions.description: Obtains the logs bloom from log entries by iterating and adding addresses and topics.

parameters.name: logs
parameters.description: Log entries to compute the bloom for.

state_variables.name: bloom
state_variables.description: Mutable bloom filter, initialized to zeros, populated by add_to_bloom calls.

sub_graphs.name: Cryptographic Dependency (keccak256)
sub_graphs.description: Documents the external dependency on keccak256. Only the first 6 bytes of the 32-byte output are used for bloom filter bit selection.

invariants.text: keccak256 always produces a 32-byte deterministic output.
Only the first 6 bytes of keccak256 output are consumed for bloom filter bit selection.
